latestRelease.updateLog:
v1.0.3

• Fixed world download: worlds now download to /saves/ correctly without requiring folder selection.
• Fixed Java 21 launch: JRE21 directory name parsing works even when release file is missing.
• Extended version list: search UI now supports versions up to 26.3.
• Added user agreement dialog on first launch.
• Added quick launch from world list context menu.
• Improved download experience with direct download dialog for all resource types.
